page.help: Every agent connected to Elysium reads this as its session starts: Claude Code and Codex over MCP, and Elysium's own coding agents and Elysia. A change reaches each agent on its next session. Elysium adds its rules after it for every agent, and no edit removes them.

claudeMd.title: CLAUDE.md
claudeMd.help: For teams that want the guidance in their repositories: paste this into a repository's CLAUDE.md. Its first line names its version, so copy it again once the guidance changes.
